memories.author: D05
memories.text: Chronic kidney disease, generalised anxiety disorder, iron-deficiency anaemia. Patient reports fatigue, occasional dyspnoea on exertion, mild worry. BP 138/86, pulse 78, SpO2 96% room air. Lung fields clear, no edema. Hb 9.2 g/dL, MCV 72 fL, ferritin 12 ng/mL. Serum creatinine 1.6 mg/dL, eGFR 45 mL/min/1.73m2, urine ACR 85 mg/g. GAD-7 score 12.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Feeling more tired lately, mild shortness of breath when climbing stairs. Anxiety seems a bit worse, worrying about finances. No new meds, taking iron tablets as prescribed but sometimes forget doses.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Allergy: rash after taking ibuprofen for headache - maculopapular rash on trunk, resolved with antihistamine. Avoid NSAIDs.
